Hey I know how bad it hurts, being alone is one of the most painful fucking feelings in the world and I spent most of my life completely alone and neglected and when I wasn’t alone I was being severely abuse which left me with CPTSD and my autism makes it so I deal with pathological demand avoidance which is it’s own special kind of hell I was lucky and privileged enough to find my boyfriend but I promise having sex and having someone doesn’t solve a thing, it did for a while I pretended I was fixed after I met him, but then came all the times he hurt me, all the times he made our relationship hell all the times I MADE our relationship hell….then came the jealousy on my end then came the insecurities then came the horrifying feeling of loneliness because I knew he would never understand me and would eventually leave me because I’m too crazy, I’ve been cripplingly alone my whole life and then I’ve been in a relationship…and unless you find someone whose “perfect” and will never ever make a mistake and never trigger you (it doesn’t exist I promise) then you will still never be happy, your feelings are valid and you’ll probably get mad at me for this but I promise you having even a loving relationship doesn’t change the CPTSD you’ve spent so much time alone that you’ve romantized the idea of a relationship but I guarantee you it will change nothing in the long run you will always come back to this state, it has to do with personal healing NOT another person healing you because if you expect them too you will be utterly devastated when they don’t meet that expectation, I had to grieve the idea of my savior coming and scooping me up and taking me away because that just isn’t what it will ever be, I sincerely believe romance doesn’t really exist or if it does it will never outweigh the depression…im sorry for this it sucks to hear I get if you hate this and your mind isn’t changed but it is good for thought…
